summary: PM Payu Muaythai is a small Thai-owned Muay Thai gym in Bophut, Koh Samui, offering group, private, small-group and kids classes plus a fight camp.

facts.label: Group schedule
facts.value: Monday to Saturday at 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, 1h 30m

facts.label: Levels
facts.value: All levels train together, beginners welcome
facts.quote: All levels train together, and beginners are welcome.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: 3 minutes walk from Fisherman's Village, Bophut
